DESCRIPTION:
Scan and analyze .NET applications source code to identify replatforming and 
migration opportunities for Azure.

USAGE:
    appcat analyze [APPLICATION] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    appcat analyze
    appcat analyze <APPLICATION_PATH>
    appcat analyze <APPLICATION_PATH> --target AppService.Windows
    appcat analyze <FOLDER_PATH> --source folder --target AppService.Windows 
--privacyMode Protected
    appcat analyze <IISSITE_NAME> --source IISServer --target AppService.Linux 
--config <CONFIG_PATH> --privacyMode Protected
    appcat analyze <APPLICATION_PATH> --report MyAppReport --serializer html 
--code --binaries --privacyMode Unrestricted

ARGUMENTS:
    [APPLICATION]    Path to the application to be analyzed (could be repo      
                     folder, solution or project file path)                     

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
    -e, --extensions <EXTENSIONSDIR>    List of directories separated by ':' and
                                        containing extension.json file with     
                                        additional extensibility assemblies     
    -c, --config <CONFIG>               Config file to customize analysis       
                                        (select binaries, add or modify analysis
                                        rules)                                  
        --non-interactive               When specified, it would only use       
                                        arguments specified in command line and 
                                        not ask questions. If any required piece
                                        of data missing it would stop and print 
                                        an error message
